rules.title: Ban on rent-pricing algorithms and coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot contract with or pay for services that collect actual rent prices, analyze them, and recommend rental prices to landlords. Service providers cannot help landlords agree not to compete on rent pricing for residential units.
rules.quotedSpan: No real estate lessor, or any agent or subcontractor thereof, shall subscribe to, contract with or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a service provider. No service provider shall facilitate an agreement to not compete among real estate lessors with respect to residential dwelling units.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential dwelling units in Massachusetts, excluding inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities.
exemptions: Publication of fair market rent calculated using publicly available data does not constitute a prohibited recommendation
